body.title: Confirm the payment request
body.nextStep: Verify who should receive the payment through a trusted, independent contact route.
body.reason:
“The public information page is
proof you can trust me.” does not authorise the separate request “transfer S$90 now to my
personal account.”. Additional supplied detail: “Read public information at
https://www.gov.sg/”. The payment recipient still needs independent verification.
body.uncertainty: A matching domain does not authenticate the sender or the requested action. Screenshot text is machine-transcribed and may contain mistakes. The screenshot does not show the payment recipient. The missing detail is not verified.

evidence.title: Host matches the reviewed Singapore Government record
evidence.detail: Actual host: www.gov.sg. Registrable domain: www.gov.sg. This check does not open the link or follow redirects; no final destination or website owner has been verified. Exact host match to a record reviewed 2026-09-26. This does not authenticate the sender, verify a redirect destination or authorise the requested action.

evidence.title: External link check not performed
evidence.detail: Image-extracted links need review before external lookup. Only local URL checks were performed.

evidence.title: Check the actual government website address
evidence.detail: Singapore government websites generally use .gov.sg. Government guidance lists exceptions and official short-link hosts. A name appearing earlier in an unrelated hostname is not a match, and a genuine host does not authenticate a separate message or payment request. Source reviewed 2026-09-26; review expires 2026-10-26. This is reference guidance, not proof about this message.
